points.description: States the circumstance: when deeper learning / more complex, hierarchical feature extraction is required, i.e. the task needs critical or non-trivial features to be learned, so extra hidden layers are needed to extract and learn these features properly and efficiently (for performing further tasks well).
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only says more hidden layers are needed for complex tasks/features but does not state feature extraction/learning by the layers.

points.description: Gives a correct example of such a problem, named precisely: multiclass classification and/or the XOR function (non-linearly separable problem).
points.partial_credit: No part marks; a wrong example or generic example (e.g. 'complex problems') earns nothing.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both the feature-learning/deep-learning circumstance stated precisely and a correct named example (multiclass classification or XOR). Part marks only if the circumstance is clearly mostly stated (e.g. complex features need more layers) without the example or without the explicit feature extraction idea. Vague answers like 'for better accuracy' or 'bigger data', or wrong examples, earn nothing for that point.
